question:
Which of the following is correct regarding the heating of the air?

I. It expands and occupies more space.

II. It becomes heavier on heating.
solution:
Correct Answer ***Only I***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Statement I:** **When air is heated, it expands and occupies more space.**

 
• This phenomenon is a result of the increase in the kinetic energy of the air molecules.
 
• As the air molecules gain energy, they move more vigorously and spread out, leading to an increase in volume and expansion of the air.
 
• This expansion is commonly observed in various situations, such as hot air rising or the expansion of air in a balloon when it is exposed to heat.

**Statement II, which suggests that air becomes heavier on heating, is incorrect.**

 
• Heating air does not cause it to become heavier.
 
• In fact, as the air expands and occupies more space when heated, its density decreases, making it lighter compared to an equal volume of cooler air.
 
• This is why hot air tends to rise above cooler air in the atmosphere.
